source: Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill ig-reel hooks.json (SF-01..26, source order and classify_order)
evidence: craft; source's own calibration: hookscore AUC 0.83 bad vs real hooks, only 0.56 hits vs misses (n=74)
rules: Write the spoken line and the on-screen line separately; on-screen 6 words or fewer.
No setup: the video starts at what would be second 6.
A static first frame wastes the hook.
If anyone in the niche could say it, it is not the user's hook.
Deliver the promise before the halfway mark.
Spoken hook <= 3 s (about 8 words at 2.5 words/s).
Examples show shape only; never reuse their numbers.

hooks.name: Cost Confession
hooks.template: {Specific amount} is what {one mistake} cost me.
hooks.example: $18,000 is what one missing clause cost me.
hooks.trap: A fake cost ('my peace of mind').

hooks.name: Negative Command
hooks.example: Stop writing captions first. Write the on-screen line first.

hooks.name: Nobody Tells You
hooks.example: Nobody tells you the first 100 videos are practice.

hooks.name: The Replacement
hooks.example: This $12 app replaced my $2,000 editor.

hooks.name: Time Collapse
hooks.template: This used to take me {long}. It now takes {short}.
hooks.example: This used to take me 5 hours. It now takes 20 minutes.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.template: I {did thing} for {N days}. Here are the actual numbers.
hooks.example: I posted a reel a day for 30 days. Here are the actual numbers.
hooks.trap: No screen recording of the numbers.

hooks.name: Wrong Way, Right Way
hooks.template: You are doing {thing} wrong, and it is not your fault.
hooks.example: You are filming hooks wrong, and it is not your fault.

hooks.name: Insider Leak
hooks.template: I spent {N years} {inside}. Here is what we never said out loud.
hooks.example: I spent 6 years inside a hiring team. Here is what we never said out loud.
hooks.best_for: follows; the years must be real

hooks.name: The Steal
hooks.example: Steal this 3-line prompt. It took me a month to get right.
hooks.trap: The artifact is not on screen.

hooks.name: If This, Then Watch
hooks.template: If you {specific situation}, this {short time} fixes it.
hooks.example: If your reels die at second 3, this 20-second fix is for you.

hooks.name: Numbered With A Favourite
hooks.template: {N} {things} that {outcome}. Number {k} is the one nobody uses.
hooks.example: 5 shortcuts that halve editing time. Number 4 is the one nobody uses.
hooks.best_for: saves; keep N at 7 or under

hooks.name: The Objection
hooks.template: "{verbatim objection}." Fine. Here is the version that works anyway.
hooks.example: "I don't have time to film." Fine. Here is the version that works anyway.

hooks.name: Before And After, On Screen
hooks.template: {Before state, shown}. {After state, shown}. One change.
hooks.example: This was my thumbnail. This is my thumbnail now.

hooks.name: The Callout
hooks.template: {Specific group}, this is the one you have been ignoring.
hooks.example: Freelance designers, this is the one you have been ignoring.
match: \bthis is the one you('ve| have) been ignoring\b

hooks.name: The Flop Record
hooks.template: My first {N} {attempts} did nothing. Here is what changed on {N+1}.
hooks.example: My first 40 reels did nothing. Here is what changed on 41.

hooks.name: The Verbatim Question
hooks.template: "{question exactly as asked}" - I get this every week.
hooks.example: "how do u get ur first client" - I get this every week.
hooks.best_for: comments and search; keep their typos

hooks.name: Head To Head
hooks.example: Notion versus a paper notebook. I ran both for a month.

hooks.name: Cold Open Demo
hooks.example: Watch what this does to a 2-hour transcript.

hooks.name: The Deadline
hooks.example: {Real policy} changes on {real date}.

hooks.name: Permission
hooks.example: You do not need a camera to start.
hooks.trap: The second half must replace what it removed.

hooks.name: Mid-Sentence Start
hooks.example: ...and that is when the client stopped replying.
hooks.best_for: watch; deliver the setup by second 8

hooks.name: Contrarian Flip
hooks.example: Nice guys finish first.

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.example: {N}% of {group} {fact} ({source named on screen}).
hooks.best_for: trust; must be sourced in the video

hooks.name: The Reveal
hooks.example: This is the new resume.

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.example: There was one {named creator} who {real outcome} in {time}.
hooks.best_for: shares; name it and link it

hooks.name: The Superlative
hooks.example: The fastest way to learn SQL is to break a real database.
